query:
select exists(
                 select 1 from token_revocations
                  where tenant_id = $1 and digest = $2 and expires_at > now()
               ) as "live!",
               (select count(*) from (
                  select 1 from token_revocations
                   where tenant_id = $1 and expires_at > now()
                   limit $3
               ) live) as "live_rows!"
